intro: A finance lead asks one question and gets a red, amber or green scorecard per module, the ranked blockers and the recommended close sequence, assembled by an orchestrator that delegates to a specialist skill per module.

cases.title: Close readiness, one question
prompts: Are we ready to close May?
What is still blocking the period close, module by module?
Give me the close scorecard for AP, AR, inventory, assets and GL, with the blockers ranked.

cases.title: Purchasing accrual leg
prompts: Does the receipt accrual tie out, and how big is the uninvoiced backlog?
Which uninvoiced receipts are the oldest and largest?
Is purchasing ready for the close?
reports: CST AP and PO Accrual Reconciliation
cases.note: Refuses to score a stale accrual snapshot green: it tells the user to run the accrual load first.

cases.title: Subledger-to-GL reconciliation
prompts: Do AP, AR, inventory and assets tie to the ledger for this period?
Where does the AP trial balance differ from the GL liability account?
Reconcile the subledgers to the general ledger for last month.
reports: CST AP and PO Accrual Reconciliation

cases.title: Close-process health and bank reconciliation readiness
prompts: Are the close programs actually running clean, and is the bank reconciliation caught up?
Which concurrent programs failed or ran long during the close?
How many bank statement lines are still unreconciled, and how old are they?

cases.title: Financial statements and variance commentary
prompts: Refresh the income statement for this period and explain the main variances to last year.
Why did operating expenses go up this month? Drill the largest movements to the journals.
Compare actuals against budget by cost center and draft the variance commentary.

cases.title: Finish a converted financial statement
prompts: Finish this statement converted from Spreadsheet Server: fix what the converter could not.
Go through the conversion log of this workbook and tell me what still needs attention.

intro: Four levers on the same goal, cash. Each is a standalone skill; the working-capital orchestrator runs them as one review.

cases.title: Duplicate payment recovery
prompts: Have we paid anyone twice in the last two years?
Find likely duplicate supplier invoices and rank them by amount at risk.
Which duplicates are already paid and recoverable, and which can still be stopped?

cases.title: Collections worklist with drafted follow-ups
prompts: Who do we chase this week, and what do we say to each of them?
Prioritise our overdue customers and draft a reminder for the top ten.
Which customers have disputed invoices holding up collection?

cases.title: Customer credit risk and DSO
prompts: Which customers are a credit risk, and why is our DSO rising?
Which customers are close to or over their credit limit?
Break down DSO by customer segment and show the biggest contributors.
reports: AR Customer Open Balances Period Lookback

cases.title: Payment run optimization
prompts: What should this week's pay run look like: what do we capture, what can wait?
Which early payment discounts are worth taking this week?
Project the cash outflow for the next four weeks of supplier payments.

cases.title: AP holds analysis and working-capital review
prompts: What is stuck on hold, why, and what could we release?
Analyse our AP invoice holds: group them by reason and age, and show the oldest ones.
Give me the full working-capital picture: payables, receivables and holds.

cases.title: Payables dashboard
prompts: Build me a payables dashboard with invoices on hold, overdue and due this week.
What needs action in AP today?

theme: Closed Loops: From Analysis to Action
intro: The AI finds it, stages the fix in EBS, and a human approves it. Every write goes through a shipped Blitz Upload: standard Oracle APIs, row-level validation, double confirmation with the money named, and a concurrent request audit trail.

cases.title: Invoice entry from documents
prompts: Here are this week's supplier PDFs: stage them as AP invoices.
Enter this invoice into Payables and tell me what does not match the supplier record.
Load these scanned invoices, but stop if any of them already exists.

cases.title: Release the holds we can
prompts: Action the holds analysis: release what qualifies.
Release the price holds under our tolerance and tell me which ones you left.

cases.title: Block the duplicates before they pay
prompts: Put the unpaid duplicate suspects on hold before the next pay run.
Hold the suspected duplicate invoices and note the evidence for the AP reviewer.

cases.title: Log the collections worklist into EBS
prompts: Record those follow-ups in Advanced Collections so the team sees them.
Save a collection note for each customer on this week's worklist.

cases.title: Act on the payment optimization
prompts: Defer what we agreed to defer, and give me the pay-now list for Payments.
Put the invoices we decided to pay next week on a payment hold with the reason.

cases.title: Account coding from the ledger's own history
prompts: Which account does this belong to, and draft the reclass journal.
Suggest the GL coding for these transactions based on how we coded them before.
Find postings that look miscoded this quarter.

cases.title: Inventory exception triage
prompts: What is broken in inventory: negative stock, stuck transactions, counts in limbo?
Which inventory interface errors are blocking costing?
List the cycle counts waiting for approval and how long they have waited.

cases.title: WIP job health and cost exposure
prompts: Which jobs are stuck, where does the WIP value sit, and what can we close?
Which discrete jobs are short of components?
Show the jobs with the largest variances before we close them.

cases.title: Supplier risk scoring
prompts: Which suppliers should procurement review this quarter, and why, in one line each?
Which suppliers cause the most invoice holds and price variances?
Score our top suppliers on dependency, delivery and price stability.

cases.title: 3-way match exception triage
prompts: Why are these invoices on match hold, and whose problem is each one?
Which match holds are waiting for a receipt, and which are price differences?
Route the quantity and price holds to receiving, buyers or AP.

cases.title: Stock level optimization
prompts: Are our min/max and safety stock settings right, and apply the approved changes.
Recommend reorder points from the last twelve months of demand.
How much working capital would the new safety stock levels free up?

cases.title: Cycle count planning
prompts: What should we count next, and why is accuracy slipping?
Which high-value items have not been counted this year?
Where do our counts miss most often?

cases.title: BOM accuracy validation
prompts: Is the bill right, or does the shop floor consume something else?
Which BOM components are never issued to jobs?
Correct the quantities per assembly where actual usage differs, after I approve them.

cases.title: Find the right report by meaning
prompts: Which report shows unapplied receipts by operating unit?
Which report shows supplier invoices on hold with the hold reason?
I need open purchase orders that were received but not invoiced: which report?

cases.title: Run any report by asking
prompts: Run GL Account Analysis for last period and summarise the largest movements by account.
Show me the open sales orders of my largest customer.
Run the AR aging for my operating unit and chart the buckets.

cases.title: Upload from Excel by asking
prompts: Upload this journal entry to the general ledger.
Create these new suppliers from the sheet.
Update the list prices on these items from my spreadsheet.

cases.title: Who changed what, when
prompts: Who changed this supplier's bank account, and give me the audit window evidence.
Who changed profile options or responsibilities in production last week?
Which users logged in with the System Administrator responsibility this month?

cases.title: Compare two instances
prompts: Did the upgrade change the numbers? Is TEST really a copy of PROD?
Compare the profile option values between TEST and PROD and list the differences.
Run the trial balance in both environments and show where they differ.

cases.title: Write your own skill
prompts: Make a skill that lists the invoices on hold entered in the last three months, ranked by amount.
Give me the holds analysis skill with our own thresholds and our custom AP report.
Turn what we just did into a skill my team can run.

intro: Reusable techniques that work on the output of any Blitz Report; the themed skills above compose them.

cases.title: Anomaly detection
prompts: Check this AP invoice data for possible duplicates and unusual amounts.
Which transactions in this sheet look wrong?
Run a Benford's Law test on these journal amounts.

cases.title: Segmentation
prompts: Segment our customers by buying behaviour and name each group.
Group these suppliers by spend pattern.
Which items behave alike?

cases.title: Forecasting
prompts: Forecast next quarter's sales from this order history.
Project cash collections for the next eight weeks.
Forecast monthly demand for these items with a confidence range.

cases.title: Customer and vendor value segments
prompts: Who are our best customers, and who is at risk of lapsing?
Run an RFM analysis on this year's invoices.
Which customers should we target for win-back?

cases.title: Dashboards on any report
prompts: Build a dashboard from this sheet with KPI cards and slicers.
Turn this report into an interactive summary for management.

theme: Blitz Report Development with Claude Code
intro: For developers: Claude Code builds, converts, tests and tunes Blitz Reports and Uploads with the Enginatics development skills.

cases.title: Create a report
prompts: Create a Blitz Report listing open purchase orders with receipts and invoices per line.
Add a supplier site parameter to this report.
Turn this SQL into a Blitz Report with parameters and lists of values.

cases.title: Convert Oracle reports
prompts: Convert our custom RDF invoice register to a Blitz Report and test it.
Convert this BI Publisher report to Blitz Report.
Analyse this Oracle report and list its queries and parameters.

cases.title: Migrate custom reports and WebADI integrators
prompts: Migrate the custom reports from this converter export to Blitz Reports.
Turn our WebADI journal integrator into a Blitz Upload.
Which of these custom reports are already covered by a standard Blitz Report?

cases.title: Test against the original
prompts: Test the new Blitz Report against the standard Oracle report with last month as parameters.
Compare the output of both reports row by row and explain the differences.

cases.title: Review the performance of a whole EBS instance
prompts: Review these DBA AWR and SGA extracts and correct the custom code behind the top SQL.
Which Blitz Reports do I run first for a server-wide performance review?
Check the memory and database parameters of this instance against the EBS requirements.

cases.title: Tune a slow report
prompts: This report takes 10 minutes. Find what makes it slow and tune the SQL.
Measure the buffer gets per row of this report and fix the expensive part.

cases.title: Build and validate an upload
prompts: Build an upload to update supplier site payment terms through the public API.
Analyse the Oracle form for this upload and list its validations.
Review this upload against the Oracle form and test it end to end.

cases.title: Extend an upload with flexfields
prompts: Add the invoice descriptive flexfield columns to this upload, with validation.
Make attribute5 of this upload validate against its value set.

cases.title: Fix a zip Oracle cannot read
prompts: The upload of this zip fails in Oracle: repack it so the import reads it.

cases.title: Set up the AI skills
prompts: Install the Blitz Report skills in Excel.
Which Blitz Report skill fits reconciling AR to the general ledger?
Set up Claude Code for Blitz Report development on our instance.
